docs.title: nams-registry
docs.text:
This is a repository of NAM and NAM-adjacent sources collected in support of a NAMs landscape analysis.

Sources are not limited to data repositories and knowledge bases. They also include reports, such as landscape analyses, reviews, and OECD Test Guidelines. Primary research papers are not included.

URI: https://w3id.org/monarch-initiative/nams-registry

Name: nams-registry

docs.title: nams-registry
docs.text:
This is a repository of NAM and NAM-adjacent sources collected in support of a NAMs landscape analysis.

Sources are not limited to data repositories and knowledge bases. They also include reports, such as landscape analyses, reviews, and OECD Test Guidelines. Primary research papers are not included.

URI: https://w3id.org/monarch-initiative/nams-registry

docs.title: Slot: preferred
docs.text: Whether this is the publication to cite for the resource.

docs.title: Slot: priority
docs.text: Extraction priority: how much the resource adds, and so how soon it is worth extracting content from. Set it once that has been investigated. A resource that repackages another one can still add value, for example through a new format, integration with other data, or easier access, so repackaging alone does not make a resource low priority.

docs.title: Slot: priority_rationale
docs.text: Why the resource was given its priority, based on what was found about what it adds. For a resource that repackages another, say what it adds beyond the original, or that nothing was found.

docs.title: Slot: publications
docs.text: For a Report, the publications the report consists of. For any other resource, publications that describe the resource.

docs.title: Slot: relevance_note
docs.text: Why the resource was given its holds_nams value, e.g. "Holds the measurement methods for key events, but its primary content is adverse outcome pathways."

docs.title: Slot: repository
docs.text: The main version control repository for the resource, if it has one.

docs.title: Slot: resource_type
docs.text: What form the resource takes, such as a data source or a knowledge graph. Imported from the KG-Registry category.

docs.title: Slot: source
docs.text: The registry the content was imported from.

docs.title: Slot: source_id
docs.text: The resource's identifier in the source registry, e.g. toxcast.

docs.title: Slot: source_url
docs.text: The URL of the resource's page in the source registry.

docs.title: Slot: source_version
docs.text: The version of the source registry the content was copied from. For a registry kept in git, such as KG-Registry, the commit hash.

docs.title: Slot: synonyms
docs.text: Acronyms, abbreviations, and other alternate names for the resource.

docs.title: Slot: title
docs.text: The title of the publication.

docs.title: Slot: use_instead
docs.text: The ids of other registry resources to use in place of this one, for a resource that is no longer active and has a clear replacement.

docs.title: Slot: year
docs.text: The year of publication, e.g. '2021'.
